decks.notes: This deck focuses on maintaining board control through a mix of removal spells and powerful creatures. The goal is to disrupt your opponent's strategy while developing your own board presence. Key cards like Chandra, Pyromaster and Rakdos's Return provide additional removal and card advantage, while threats like Stormbreath Dragon and Polukranos, World Eater put pressure on your opponent. The mana base is built to support a mix of red, black, and green spells, allowing for flexibility in casting your spells on curve. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast your opponent in a longer game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with low cost, evasive creatures like Cloudfin Raptor and Judge's Familiar, while using powerful enchantments like Hall of Triumph and Bident of Thassa to pump up the team. Thassa, God of the Sea provides card advantage and ensures consistent damage output. Master of Waves generates a swarm of elemental tokens to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Tidebinder Mage and Cyclonic Rift to control the board and protect your creatures. Overall, the goal is to apply early pressure and maintain momentum to win the game swiftly.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy with a mix of removal spells like Bile Blight and Abrupt Decay, along with hand disruption in the form of Thoughtseize. The deck aims to pressure the opponent with efficient creatures like Desecration Demon and Gray Merchant of Asphodel, while also gaining card advantage with cards like Underworld Connections. Pack Rat is included for its ability to quickly generate threats, while Lifebane Zombie can provide additional disruption against certain opponents. The deck also includes a small package of lands to support the Golgari color identity.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a swarm of aggressive red creatures. By playing small, efficient creatures like Foundry Street Denizen and Rakdos Cackler early on, and following up with powerful cards like Goblin Rabblemaster and Stoke the Flames, the deck aims to deal damage fast and efficiently. Additionally, cards like Legion Loyalist and Ash Zealot provide extra value and disruption against opposing strategies. With a focus on speed and efficiency, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize and turn the tide in their favor.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent. With a mix of burn spells and creatures that can deal direct damage, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Warleader's Helix adds versatility and reach to the deck, allowing for both aggressive tactics and finishing blows. The deck also includes cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel to punish opponents for casting spells, further increasing the pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to use fast and efficient burn spells to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. By combining cheap removal spells like Shock and Lightning Strike with powerful burn spells like Warleader's Helix and Stoke the Flames, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and close out the game quickly. Young Pyromancer and Chandra's Phoenix provide additional threats that can also generate value from casting spells. The inclusion of Mutavault as a creature land adds versatility to the deck's aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a combination of burn spells and aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes efficient removal spells like Shock and Lightning Strike, alongside powerful creatures like Chandra's Phoenix and Young Pyromancer to apply pressure to the opponent. With cards like Boros Charm and Warleader's Helix providing reach and versatility, the deck aims to close out games quickly through a mix of direct damage and creature combat. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of red and white lands.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to stall the game and control the board using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw until the player can establish a dominant position and win with powerful finishers like Sphinx's Revelation and Aetherling. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game and out-value the opponent by efficiently answering threats and generating card advantage. Elixir of Immortality can also be used to recycle key spells and prevent milling. The mana base includes various dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells across different colors.

The main concept of this Orzhov Aggro deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's board while staying aggressive with strong threats. The deck includes removal spells like Hero's Downfall, Bile Blight, and Ultimate Price to deal with opposing creatures, as well as hand disruption with Thoughtseize. The creatures in the deck, such as Desecration Demon, Blood Baron of Vizkopa, and Pack Rat, provide a quick clock against the opponent. The deck also has card advantage through Underworld Connections and life gain with Gray Merchant of Asphodel to outvalue the opponent and win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence with low-cost creatures like Experiment One and Soldier of the Pantheon, backed up by powerful midrange threats like Loxodon Smiter and Fleecemane Lion. It aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient plays and resilient creatures like Voice of Resurgence. The deck also emphasizes the use of instant-speed removal and combat tricks with cards like Selesnya Charm to control the board while applying pressure. Ajani, Caller of the Pride provides additional threats and can finish off opponents quickly.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creature threats and disruptive spells. Utilizing cards like Pack Rat and Desecration Demon, the deck aims to apply constant pressure to the opponent while also using cards like Thoughtseize and Bile Blight to disrupt their game plan. With strong card advantage engines like Underworld Connections and resilient threats like Gray Merchant of Asphodel, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of removal spells like Hero's Downfall and Devour Flesh ensures that the deck can deal with opposing threats efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells and removing threats on the board. It utilizes counterspells like Dissolve and Syncopate, board wipes like Planar Cleansing and Supreme Verdict, and card draw with cards like Divination and Sphinx's Revelation. The deck also includes versatile cards like Azorius Charm and Jace, Architect of Thought to manipulate the game state. With a mix of removal, counters, and card advantage, this UW Control deck aims to survive the early game and establish dominance in the late game.

The main focus of this Aggro Red Deck Wins deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive offense. The strategy revolves around playing low-cost, efficient creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary, Foundry Street Denizen, and Rakdos Cackler early in the game to deal damage quickly. Cards like Goblin Rabblemaster and Stoke the Flames provide additional firepower to finish off the opponent. The deck aims to close out the game as fast as possible before the opponent can stabilize and mount a defense.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board state through a blend of removal, planes walkers, and powerful creatures. By using a mix of Planeswalkers like Garruk and Vraska, along with removal spells like Hero's Downfall and Putrefy, this deck aims to keep the opponent's threats in check. The inclusion of cards like Courser of Kruphix and Sylvan Caryatid provide ramp and card advantage, while finishers like Blood Baron of Vizkopa and Elspeth, Sun's Champion help to close out the game. With a solid mana base, this Jund Control deck is well-rounded and adaptable to different situations.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments in order to deal damage and control the board. By utilizing creatures like Cloudfin Raptor, Nightveil Specter, and Master of Waves, as well as enchantments such as Bident of Thassa and Thassa, God of the Sea, you can establish dominance early in the game. The inclusion of counter spells like Thassa's Rebuff and removal spells like Rapid Hybridization provide additional control options to keep your opponent on the back foot and secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by powerful support cards like Selesnya Charm and Ajani, Caller of the Pride. The deck focuses on creating a board presence quickly with cards like Voice of Resurgence and Experiment One, while also being able to remove threats with cards like Banishing Light. By playing efficient creatures and utilizing combat tricks, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently to outpace the opponent and secure victory.
